description: Renovate keeps the Terraform providers and the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions current. Every update arrives as a pull request and has to pass the required checks before it merges.
Auto-merge: minor, patch and digest updates merge through GitHub native auto-merge once those checks pass.
MAJOR updates stay manual, because they can need code changes.
Provider updates never merge themselves: a merge to main runs terraform apply against the live Fastly service, so read the plan on the pull request first.

packageRules.description: Keep major updates manual - they need review before merging.
A merge applies the change to Fastly, so provider updates wait for a person.
